title: The next 20: Powering the future of entertainment together at Made on YouTube
period: The preceding four years as described by the announcement
location: Opening paragraphs
note_en: Supports the cumulative payout and platform role. Company disclosure covers creators, artists and media companies; it does not report independent-creator net earnings, their distribution or four specified calendar years.

title: The Podcast Consumer 2026
location: p. 28 (PDF index 27), Service Used Most Often to Consume Podcasts
note_en: U.S. weekly podcast consumers aged 13+: YouTube 37%, Spotify 21%, Apple Podcasts 12%, other services 30%. Primary-platform preference, not revenue, time or whole-industry share. Other is reported directly. No sample size from a different survey within the report is assigned to this chart.

title: Digital Ad Revenue Climbs to Nearly $300B as IAB Celebrates 30 Year Anniversary
location: Redefining the Market in 2026 AI Creators and Performance
note_en: Supports approximately US$37bn of U.S. creator ad spending in 2025 and a US$44bn 2026 forecast. The latter is not a completed-year result. Overlapping digital-ad categories are not combined into a pie chart.

title: YouTube partner earnings overview
location: Revenue share rates and How do I earn revenue
note_en: Watch Page share is 55% of relevant net advertising revenue; Shorts share is 45% of the creator’s allocated pool amount. Denominators differ. These terms do not establish fixed earnings per view or platform net profit.

title: YouTube channel monetization policies
period: Policy clarification and live page read 2026-11-03
location: Opening policy update and Inauthentic content
note_en: Supports the clarification and renaming concerning repetitive or mass-produced content. It does not prohibit all AI-assisted work or all derivative commentary. Future-effective provisions are not treated as operative rules.

title: A standard platform fee for new creators — effective after August 4, 2025
location: Who does this plan apply to and Payment processing rates
note_en: The 10% standard platform fee applies to pages published after August 4, 2025, with processing charges additional. Earlier pages can retain legacy pricing subject to exceptions such as unpublishing and republishing. It is not a universal fee for every creator.

title: How much does Substack cost?
location: Opening paragraph and How much do creators pay
note_en: Free publishing; paid subscriptions incur a 10% platform fee plus payment charges. The remaining 90% is not profit. U.S. card rates are not generalized across countries, and availability for a Chinese business is not established here.

title: Results announcement for the three and six months ended June 30 2026
location: p. 31 note 3 Revenue; p. 42 GMV definition
note_en: RMB millions: revenue 69,251; marketing 40,282; live streaming 17,182; other 11,787. Unaudited, reviewed interim figures. Other includes commerce and AI activities, not solely commissions. Group revenue differs from creator receipts and GMV.

title: Interim results announcement for the six months ended June 30 2026
location: p. 10 income statement and p. 24 note 5 revenue disaggregation
note_en: Supports H1 2026 net revenue of RMB15,411,958 thousand and advertising of RMB5,719,547 thousand. Advertising share is 5,719,547 / 15,411,958 = 37.1111%; total growth is about 7.5% and ad growth about 29%. Gross margin is 37.2% and net profit RMB541,071 thousand. The group includes value-added services and games; these are not creator receipts or studio margins.

title: 第57次中国互联网络发展状况统计报告 The 57th Statistical Report on Internet Development in China
location: Printed p. 23 Table 5; PDF index 29
note_en: Mainland China survey scope is age 6+. Short video: 1,074.03m users, 95.4%; live streaming: 813.59m, 72.3%. The original CNNIC report was read via an Eastmoney-hosted mirror after the official PDF timed out; the official release page was verified separately. Mirror dates do not replace publication date. Audiences overlap; these are not MAU or creator counts.
kind: Original statistical report read through a mirror

title: 关于加强自媒体管理的通知 Notice on strengthening management of self-media
location: Items 2 3 8 9 and 11
note_en: Supports professional-domain verification, source attribution, affiliation and monetization governance. It does not establish one specified license for every general industry commentator.

title: 互联网广告管理办法 Measures for the Administration of Internet Advertising
location: Order 72 Articles 2 4 9 14 and 18
note_en: Supports ad recognizability and relevant advertising-operator/publisher duties including advertiser verification and at least three years of advertising records. Absence of a purchase link does not exclude advertising status, and commercial-ad duties are not imposed on all noncommercial articles. The webpage separately shows March 20, 2023.

title: 人工智能生成合成内容标识办法 Measures for Labeling AI Generated Synthetic Content
location: Articles 2 4 5 6 10 and 14
note_en: Supports explicit and implicit labels and relevant declaration and labeling duties. Scope follows the text; it is not a global rule or an identical obligation for every possible use of AI assistance.

title: FTC Endorsement Guides What People Are Asking
location: Opening explanation and What is the legal basis for the Guides
note_en: Supports material-connection disclosures and non-misleading endorsements. The guides explain FTC views on Section 5 of the FTC Act and do not themselves have the force of law. Application depends on facts.

title: Professional video editing software Adobe Premiere
location: Editing Audio and Titles
note_en: Supports editing, audio and caption capabilities only. Dynamic prices, rankings and efficiency promises are not adopted.

title: CapCut AI Video Editor
location: Products Smart Editor and Generator AI Editing Tools
note_en: Supports editing, template and AI-assisted creation roles. Vendor marketing is not independent evidence of results or market share.

title: Creator Economy Ad Spend to Reach $37 Billion in 2025, Growing 4x Faster than Total Media Industry, According to IAB
location: Opening estimate and Methodology
note_en: Defines intentional U.S. brand investment in creator partnerships, promotion and related advertising. This release treated 2025 as a forecast; the body uses E03 for the later 2025 review. Updates from the same institution are not independent corroboration.

title: From Audio to Video, Spotify’s $100 Million Payout Fuels Creator Success Stories
location: Opening payout statement and payment description
note_en: Supports quarterly payments exceeding US$100m to podcast publishers and podcasters globally, including ads and partner-program revenue. It is not music royalties or payments from one program alone. Company disclosure does not establish industry share.

title: How to create a new Creator marketing project in TikTok One
location: Opening explanation; How to invite creators; To publish the video
note_en: Supports brand projects, creator sourcing and invitations, negotiation, review, publication and ad authorization. Regional and eligibility conditions apply; no universal availability, effectiveness or share ranking is established.

title: Making it Easier for Brands and Creators to Collaborate on Instagram
location: How it works and Partnership ads discussion
note_en: Supports creator discovery, portfolios, partnership messages and advertising roles. A 2024 product introduction is not a 2026 worldwide availability list or independent effectiveness evidence.

title: 巨量星图 抖音营销 达人变现 星图营销服务平台 Douyin Xingtu creator marketing services
location: Brand creator and MCN services; measurement description
note_en: Supports brand, agency, creator and MCN matching, collaboration tasks and campaign measurement. Product marketing does not establish competitive superiority; dynamic rankings are not used.

title: 小红书蒲公英 好产品种草第一站 Xiaohongshu Pugongying creator partnerships
location: Official homepage introduction; collaboration and live-streaming modules
note_en: Supports recommendation-content and live collaborations, creator selection, invitations and campaign review. Search extraction was empty; the official page was read directly in a browser. Promotional effectiveness claims and dynamic rankings are not adopted.

title: 公众号 Official Accounts and 视频号 Channels
location: Product introductions
note_en: Supports Official Accounts publishing and follower communication, routes to websites and commerce, and Channels video creation and connected Weixin services. Overall Weixin users are not assigned to these products, and complete creator control over distribution is not implied.

title: Multi-Channel Network (MCN) overview for YouTube Creators
location: Key aspects of working with MCNs; Signing a contract with an MCN; Revenue & getting paid
note_en: Supports MCN roles, contract considerations, unchanged YouTube revenue share and receipt through the MCN’s AdSense account with potential network deductions. Platform-specific explanation, not a universal description of agency contracts or evidence of higher creator earnings.

title: Podcast RSS feed requirements
location: Opening requirements and Podcast RSS feed technical requirements
note_en: Supports self-generated or hosting-provider RSS feeds and technical requirements for media and metadata. Illustrates separation of hosting and listening interfaces; does not establish transferability of recommendations, all audience relationships or paid entitlements.

title: Understand ad revenue analytics
location: RPM; What is the difference between RPM and CPM; CPM
note_en: CPM measures advertiser spending per thousand ad impressions. RPM is after revenue sharing and can combine several sources. Shorts uses engaged views, unlike the long-form view denominator. The report does not treat blended RPM as an advertising rate or multiply CPM by all views to infer earnings.

title: Associates Program Policies
location: Associates Program Commission Income Statement sections 1, 2 and 6
note_en: Supports the distinction between qualifying purchases and revenue, exclusion of initiated cancellations, returns or refunds, and payment approximately 60 days after the earning month. Thresholds and detailed conditions apply. U.S. Amazon program example, not a general rule for commerce or average creator earnings.

title: YouTube performance FAQ and Troubleshooting
location: Discovery FAQs; How are videos ranked on Home and in Search
note_en: Supports personalized homepage discovery and search relevance. Platform description does not disclose model weights or guarantee reach; it cannot establish revenue per view.

title: Kuaishou Technology Announces Second Quarter and Interim 2026 Unaudited Financial Results
location: First Half 2026 Key Highlights; Condensed Consolidated Income Statement
note_en: H1 revenue RMB69,251m, gross profit RMB35,577m and operating profit RMB7,352m, versus operating profit RMB9,548m a year earlier. Gross margins 51.4% and 55.1%. Group accounts do not measure creator profits. The original E08 static PDF endpoint returned 403 on this review; the same-date corporate HTML release and linked PDF were read to cross-check total revenue and profits.

title: For You on TikTok
location: What is For You on TikTok; Why do you see certain posts on TikTok
note_en: Supports personalization through interests and interactions. Listed factors are not a complete algorithm disclosure or evidence of fixed reach thresholds or ranking formulas.

title: How do I export my email list on Substack
location: Export instructions and CSV column choices
note_en: Supports CSV export of subscriber email lists. Does not establish complete portability of all data, followers or payment relationships; migration cost and consent implications are analytical observations.

title: YouTube Partner Program overview and eligibility
location: What you need to join; How you can become eligible
note_en: Supports availability by residence and account/policy review requirements. The page mentions terms effective February 2027; those future terms are not treated as operative rules. No individual operator’s eligibility is determined.

title: YouTube Partner Program availability
location: You can sign up in the following areas
note_en: The complete list read did not include mainland China; it included areas such as Hong Kong. Establishes that language alone does not determine availability, not personal tax, account or relocation advice.

title: About and Ethics Statement
date: Undated live page; sponsorship disclosure references October 2026
location: About opening; Ethics Statement
note_en: Supports free weekly articles, paid updates, and an October 2026 Stripe sponsorship disclosure acknowledging conflict. Publisher self-description establishes product structure and disclosure, not audited income, profit or a guarantee of objectivity.

title: Stratechery Plus
location: Opening price; product description; team subscription FAQ
note_en: Lists US$15/month or US$150/year for analysis updates, interviews and podcasts, with team subscriptions. A dated observation of one offer, not an industry average or purchase recommendation; no subscriber or revenue estimate is inferred.

title: Invalid traffic on your videos
location: How invalid traffic impacts your earnings
note_en: Supports possible ad restrictions, earnings adjustments or offsets, and payment delays of up to 90 days for invalid traffic. It does not attribute every revenue fluctuation or payment delay to violations or establish enforcement against a particular creator.

title: About Conversion Lift
location: Opening eligibility note; How Conversion Lift works
note_en: Supports exposed-versus-control measurement of incremental conversions and limited account availability. This tool explanation does not establish incremental sales from any specific creator campaign. The discussion of measurement limits is methodological analysis.

title: Can I Use Someone Else's Work Can Someone Else Use Mine
location: Questions How much of someone else's work can I use without getting permission and Could I be sued for using somebody else's work
note_en: The U.S. Copyright Office explains that fair use depends on circumstances and has no universal safe threshold based on words, notes or percentages. This is general U.S. guidance, not a determination for a particular use or another jurisdiction.

title: 网信部门依法查处剪映App等生成合成内容标识违法问题网站平台 AI content labeling enforcement against Jianying and other platforms
location: First substantive paragraph
note_en: The notice identifies labeling implementation issues involving Jianying, Maoxiang and Jimeng AI and describes measures including interviews, correction orders and warnings. It does not match every measure to each product, state a monetary fine, or establish a general ban or wrongdoing by all users.

title: Welcome to 404 Media
organization: 404 Media / Jason Koebler, Samantha Cole, Emanuel Maiberg and Joseph Cox
location: Opening paragraphs and subscriber offer
note_en: The founders describe ownership by four former Motherboard journalists and a reader-supported mix of free and paid work. This is a launch statement, not evidence of realized profitability or typical creator outcomes.

title: Membership
location: Free and Supporter tiers
note_en: Supports the tier structure and listed Supporter prices of US$10 monthly or US$100 annually. It does not disclose realized prices, membership, revenue or profit. Offers can change.
